# GREMLINS

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/GrossSBM/GREMLINS/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/GrossSBM/GREMLINS/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

GREMLINS fits block models to **multipartite networks**: collections of simple and bipartite networks involving
common groups of nodes (the *functional groups*), binary or weighted, possibly with missing values.
The model and its inference are described in [Bar-Hen, Barbillon and Donnet (2022)](https://doi.org/10.1177/1471082X20963254).

> **Please use GREMLINS through the package [`sbm`](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=sbm).**
> GREMLINS is the inference engine of `sbm`, whose function `estimateMultipartiteSBM()` implements the same model and
> algorithm with a simpler interface (shared with simple, bipartite and multiplex networks), plot functions and examples.
> GREMLINS is maintained as a back-end of `sbm`.

## Installation

``` r
# Recommended: the package sbm, which uses GREMLINS
install.packages("sbm")

# GREMLINS alone, released version
install.packages("GREMLINS")
# GREMLINS, development version
# remotes::install_github("GrossSBM/GREMLINS")
```

## Documentation

The documentation of multipartite block models is in the [vignettes of `sbm`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/articles/):

- *Stochastic Block Models for Multipartite networks: principle*: the model, its inference and an illustration on simulated data,
- *Multipartite Stochastic Block Models*: the analysis of a mutualistic ecological network.

The vignette of GREMLINS gives the correspondence between the functions of the two packages:
`vignette("Introduction", package = "GREMLINS")`.

## Citation

Bar-Hen, A., Barbillon, P. and Donnet, S. (2022). Block models for generalized multipartite networks: Applications in ecology and ethnobiology.
*Statistical Modelling*, 22(4), 273–296. [doi:10.1177/1471082X20963254](https://doi.org/10.1177/1471082X20963254)
